title: Room Reservations Training Note: Long Stays and the Room-Type Move Supplement
content:
**The rule.** When a Room Reservations reservation is moved to a room type that sleeps its registered adults, the move supplement is charged on a share of the stay's nights that depends on the length of the stay and on how early it was booked. For a stay of at least a week of nights (7 nights), the supplement is charged on the nights left after one free night for every full week, spread evenly over all nights of the stay; for a stay of at least 5 nights but less than a week that was booked at least 120 days before arrival, it is charged on every night but one, spread evenly over all nights of the stay; any other stay pays the supplement on every night.

**Q. How are the nights and the lead time counted?**
The stay is the nights from the arrival date to the departure date on the reservation. The lead time is the calendar days from the booked date to the arrival date.

**Q. What does "spread evenly over all nights" mean for the nightly rate?**
The room-type differential for each night is multiplied by the share of nights charged — the nights charged divided by all nights of the stay, taken as an exact fraction — so that every night of the stay carries the same supplement.

**Q. Does the lead time matter for a stay of a week or more?**
No. A stay of 7 nights or more takes one free night for every full week whatever its lead time.

**Q. Which stays pay on every night?**
Stays of 4 nights or fewer, and stays of 5 or 6 nights booked fewer than 120 days before arrival.

**Shares worked through (hypothetical stays)**

| Nights | Booked days before arrival | Free nights | Share of nights charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| 14 | 30 | 2 (two full weeks) | 12 of 14 |
| 10 | 200 | 1 (one full week) | 9 of 10 |
| 7 | 10 | 1 | 6 of 7 |
| 6 | 120 | 1 | 5 of 6 |
| 6 | 119 | 0 | 6 of 6 (every night) |
| 4 | 300 | 0 | 4 of 4 (every night) |

**Q. What does a differential of 70.00 per night come to on a 7-night stay?**
70.00 multiplied by 6 of 7 is 60.00 per night, on every night of the stay.
